# v0.2.1 — Lower Recorder load and reliable charging control

Measurement updates now default to **30 seconds**, reducing Home Assistant
Recorder writes while status, errors and control readback retain their
**five-second** default. Charging and connection state changes refresh
measurements and lifetime energy counters in the same status poll.

This also applies to existing entries without a measurement interval setting.
If your automations require faster power or current measurements, change
**Measurement interval** in the integration options. The heartbeat remains
independent. Upgrading from 0.2.0 does not require reconfiguration.

A synthetic 24-hour replay through real Home Assistant and SQLite measured
71% fewer state rows with four hours of charging, and 81% fewer with continuous
charging. These are scenario results, not a disk-space guarantee. Recorder
retention, unused detail sensors and other integrations still affect storage.
See the [Recorder guide](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.2.1/docs/recorder.md)
for measurements, tradeoffs and an optional configuration example.

## Fixes

- An older deferred current setting can no longer overwrite a newer accepted
  setting or undo a charging pause. Shutdown waits for deferred work to stop.
- Error recovery respects the five-second current-write floor. Pause/resume
  hysteresis applies only when recovery actually ends a pause; repeated
  recovery otherwise remains possible after five seconds. A blocked recovery
  reports failure instead of silently deferring its final write.
- Heartbeats retain priority between individual fallback register reads.
- A failed unload keeps the connection and heartbeat alive. Failed or
  cancelled setup releases the serial connection and background tasks.
- Diagnostics omit serial-number register words and redact known identifiers
  from transport errors. Failed-block diagnostics persist until a successful
  read instead of disappearing during skipped polls.
- Non-finite write values and fractional enum values are rejected.

Home Assistant **2026.9.0 or newer** is required. Automated validation uses
real Home Assistant and simulated Modbus RTU hardware; physical-wallbox
verification remains outstanding.

For upgrades from 0.1.0, follow the
[domain migration guide](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.2.1/docs/upgrading.md).
Use `ha-mennekes-amtron.zip` for HACS or `ha-mennekes-amtron-manual.zip` for
manual installation. Checksums, build metadata and an SPDX SBOM accompany
both archives.
